name: Subject-wise Interactive EduGame Zone
purpose: Turn approved pharmacy curriculum content into short, engaging, subject-linked learning games without replacing serious study or assessment.
principles: Every game must map to a programme, semester, subject and topic where possible.
Games reinforce learning; game scores must not be treated as official academic marks unless explicitly configured as an assessment.
Use approved content/question pools as the factual source.
Randomize questions, choices, rounds and item order to reduce answer-sharing.
Do not expose answer keys in the client before an answer is submitted.
Avoid manipulative mechanics, forced ads or interruptions during active play.
Accessibility is required: keyboard support, readable text, non-colour-only feedback and reduced-motion support.
Suspicious gameplay patterns may be flagged, but a flag is not proof of cheating.

game_types.name: Rapid Fire
game_types.description: Short timed topic rounds using randomized approved MCQs.

game_types.name: Match the Pairs
game_types.description: Match terms with definitions, drugs with classes, concepts with examples or other approved relationships.

game_types.name: Sort It Right
game_types.description: Arrange items into the correct category, sequence or workflow.

game_types.name: Identify the Concept
game_types.description: Identify a pharmacy concept from a short clue, scenario or approved visual.

game_types.name: Case Challenge
game_types.description: Choose the most appropriate educational response to a syllabus-linked scenario.

game_types.name: True or False
game_types.description: Fast concept-check rounds with randomized statements.

game_types.name: Fill the Gap
game_types.description: Complete a missing term, step or concept from approved learning material.

game_types.name: Memory Cards
game_types.description: Pair related approved concepts for spaced recall practice.

game_types.name: Drug Class Match
game_types.description: Practice drug/class/indication relationships where supported by the approved content.

game_types.name: Lab Sequence
game_types.description: Order approved practical steps or laboratory workflows correctly.

subject_examples: Any future approved subject in the curriculum registry

progress.rule: Use game performance primarily for formative feedback and engagement. Do not infer academic mastery from one game session.

requirements: Server-authoritative sessions when backend is implemented.
Fresh randomized item selection from controlled pools.
Do not award leaderboard points for invalid or incomplete sessions.
Record audit events for high-value competitive modes.
Do not reveal whether an answer is correct until the intended feedback point.

monetization.policy: Ads may appear in non-active-play surfaces, but must not obscure questions, interrupt an active round or incentivize unsafe behaviour.
monetization.rule: Never sell academic accuracy, official certification or guaranteed outcomes.

content_governance.source: Approved content library and verified curriculum mappings
content_governance.ai_generation: AI may propose new game items from approved material, but generated items remain draft until configured approval is completed.
content_governance.global_disclaimer: Games are educational practice tools. Scores and rankings do not guarantee examination, employment, admission or career outcomes.
